Hymn 225: We Are Marching On to Glory
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Joseph J. Daynes
Lyricist/Text Author: John M. Chamberlain
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 225 titled "We Are Marching On to Glory" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph J. Daynes and the lyrics were written by John M. Chamberlain.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
